method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: God places a successor on the earth and teaches him the names of everything, which shows what the angels, who knew only what they were taught, did not know.
ideas: Keys handed to a young person at the door of a house above an untouched valley
A relay baton passed at dawn on an empty country road
A child pointing out plants to a kneeling elder in a garden
A table of a hundred objects with a hand holding up one seed
A student answering at the front of a silent class
An elder's hand resting on a young shoulder above a valley

sections.meaning: All bow to Adam but Iblis, who refuses out of pride; Satan makes Adam and his spouse slip from the garden; Adam receives words and turns back, God turns back to him, and they go down to the earth where guidance will come.
ideas: Reeds bending in a stream beside one stiff dead tree
A circle of people bowing with one man standing apart
Two people entering a garden with one tree set apart behind a ring of stones
Hands picking fruit with the forbidden tree behind
Two people going down a hill path away from a garden
A man alone at dawn with open hands and a green shoot at his feet
A porch lamp lit for a returning traveler
Orange markers leading a hiker through snow

sections.meaning: Keep the covenant: both sides keep their part, do not sell the signs for a small price or mix truth with falsehood, pray together, and do not command others to virtue while forgetting yourselves.
ideas: A bridge built from both banks meeting in the middle
Two farmers each mending their half of a footbridge
A child trading a gold coin for a lollipop
A woman selling a ring to a pawnbroker for a few bills
A drop of black ink falling into a clear glass of water
A clear stream and a muddy stream meeting in one river
People kneeling side by side in a plain bright room
A gardener tending a neighbor's flowers while his own garden is overgrown
A man painting a neighbor's fence while his own roof falls in

sections.meaning: Remember the favor, and guard against the day when no soul can pay for another; remember being saved from Pharaoh's people when the sea was parted.
ideas: Hands pushing a handful of coins back across a counter
A barred window sliding shut on an offered envelope
A cut iron chain lying in the dust at dawn
A bird released from a cage at sunrise
A dry path through a parted sea between walls of water
A calm sea closed over, with floating planks at sunrise

sections.meaning: After Moses is gone forty nights they take a calf for themselves, are pardoned, are given the Book that separates right from wrong, and are told to turn back to their Maker.
ideas: A golden calf on a plain at the foot of a mountain
A cloud-capped mountain with a glint of gold at its foot
A worn book on a flat rock turning its pages in the wind
A fork in the road, one path lit and one dark
A long line of ordinary people all turned around on a road, walking back toward the dawn
One person on a riverbank turning round on the path

sections.meaning: They said they would not believe until they saw God in plain sight; the thunderbolt took them; they were raised after their death; they were shaded by clouds and fed manna and quails.
ideas: A bolt of lightning from a clear sky over an empty plain
A great thundercloud over a row of empty chairs
Snowdrops pushing through melting snow
Someone waking in a sunlit bed
Cloud shade and white flakes of manna with quail on the desert ground
People gathering white flakes in baskets under a cloud

sections.meaning: Enter the town, bowing at the gate, and say 'Unburden us'; those who put another saying in its place got a plague from the sky.
ideas: Travelers stooping through a low stone gate into a hill town
A traveler setting down a huge sack at a town gate
A dark cloud of locusts over a farm field
Ash falling from a black sky over a town

sections.meaning: Moses asks for water and twelve springs gush out of the rock, each group knowing its own drinking place; but they tire of one food and ask for lower things in place of the better.
ideas: Twelve streams from one rock face each filling its own pool
Twelve cups under twelve taps of one stone
A table of cucumbers, onions, garlic, lentils and greens beside an untouched loaf
A traveler kneeling at a muddy puddle beside a clear spring
A grand house falling into ruin
A padlocked rusted gate with weeds and cracked pavement
